boundsSource: SceneGenerator.bounds(for:) actual rotated/freeform vertices after center attachment
centerPassLimit: Center-layout Core decoding can reject deep graphs at its global-position gate; this single-chair depth-one probe does not establish a general nested evaluator
contactLimit: World AABB attachment is not proof of actual surface contact for hollow, concave or torus geometry
coordinates: World-axis face directions, matching the existing resolver; not parent-local axes
formula: tangent sign * max(0, (parent actual AABB extent - child actual AABB extent) / 2)
insideScope: Only center is supported by this prototype
zeroSpreadLimit: Requested non-center axes with zero spread collapse; record as a quality failure, never scale or nudge
